# Personal outreach for every contact in Salesforce.

Connect Salesforce, and your contacts, the fields you track and your campaigns come into Levitate on their own. Use them to send the right message to the right people, and every email, call, card and text is logged back in Salesforce.

[Book a Demo](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations/salesforce#book-a-demo) [All integrations](https://www.levitate.ai/integrations)

## Reach the right people without building a list

Campaign membership, interests, account details and your custom fields all come into Levitate as tags. Email every contact in a Salesforce campaign, or everyone at one kind of account, in a few clicks.
